text:
sasha: heads-up: I'm pulling together the docs changelog for the 0.11.1 ship. Need final confirmations on breaking notes and any snippets that must be called out. Can folks drop single-line items here?

liam: short list from eng: 1) streaming SDK rename (`stream()` -> `generate_stream()`), 2) cache TTL default lowered to 1800s (impacts long-context sessions), 3) routing fallback change prefers lower-cost variants for background workloads.

priya: docs PR 4222 updates python/chat quickstart to the new streaming API. I left a note in the PR about chunking behavior and suggested `chunk_size=2048` as a conservative default.

jules: I fixed two link rot issues in examples/embeddings.md and guides/secure-deploy.md in PR 4230. CI flagged one more: examples/embeddings-quickstart.md -> /sdk/py/embeddings returns 404 on staging.

docs-bot: reminder: release branch doc-0.11.1 requires changelog.md entry and a Known Issues section before merge.

liam: for the changelog entry, suggest sections: "What changed", "For engineers (config diffs)", "Known issues & workarounds", "Migration notes". Keep the engineers section very terse with 1-2 code snippets.

sasha: agree. Draft bullet for engineers: 
- adaptive routing opt-in: add `routing.beta.enabled: true` in service config (example below)

```
# enable beta adaptive routing for service
service:
  routing:
    beta:
      enabled: true
      prefer_cost_for_background: true
```

priya: migration note: dedicated->private guide needs `kvs_cache` mention. Small YAML to include in migration-guides/dedicated-to-private.md (PR 4241):

```
# ensure prefix KV cache remains active after migration
kvs_cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

jules: also a docs style nit: examples/quantization.md should not reference internal model tag `q4_0`; switch to an abstract family `--model-family gpt-small-quant`. I've opened PR 4245 for that swap.

ci-bot: lint: 3 warnings across PRs(4222,4230,4241). One blocking: markdown link to /sdk/py/embeddings (404).

liam: can someone fix the embedding link and we can merge. Also add known-issue item: "Streaming SDK v0.9.x may drop final chunk when client chunk sizes are <1024 bytes; workaround: upgrade to v0.10.x or set `chunk_size >= 1024`." Keep wording short.

sasha: I'll add that under Known issues and do voice polishing. Timeline: aim to merge snippet/link PRs by 18:30Z, freeze for copy edits until 19:15Z, then release window at 20:00Z. I'll post the changelog draft to the PR once copyedits are in.

priya: one more, the Quickstarts call out `--quantize q4_0` in examples; changed that to `--model-family gpt-small-quant` in my fork. We should include a short footnote in the relnotes: "Model family names are preferred over internal tags in examples."

jules: ack. I'll scope a tiny "How to enable" section for adaptive routing with the minimal flags and a note about expected SLO differences.

sasha: perfect. If anyone sees anything else noisy in the docs CI, drop it here. Otherwise I'll post the final changelog snippet in ~30m. Thanks! :sparkles:
